about_the_game:
Imagine a gameplay experience that masterfully blends the precise, tactical combat of classics like XCOM or Age of Wonders 4, the intricate management and simulation depth of Football Manager, and the immersive, relationship-driven narratives reminiscent of Crusader Kings 3. Prepare to engage in a strategic fantasy sport journey filled with tactical battles, emotional storylines, and profound managerial challenges—your path to the Empyrean League awaits.

Take on the role of a manager leading a team of skilled warriors from 7 different classes competing in intense 8v8 matches. Each team fields five active players on the pitch, with an additional three substitutes available for tactical substitutions during the match.

Battle mechanics offer rich tactical depth, including hexagonal grids that encourage strategic positioning, action points that govern movement and skill usage, zones of control to influence enemy maneuverability, opportunity and retaliation attacks that punish reckless moves, flanking bonuses that reward tactical positioning, elemental affinities (fire, lightning, ice) adding depth to resistances and attacks, and various status effects that dynamically alter combat conditions.

The complexity of the game extends beyond battles. Manage your team's training regimens, monitor player fatigue, prevent injuries, and carefully plan match rotations to maintain peak performance throughout a grueling season. Strategically navigate league competitions with multiple tiers, each filled with ambitious rivals fighting for the same promotion spots and championship titles. Every decision counts as you adapt your strategies, scout opponents, and ensure your team consistently performs at their best.

Your managerial decisions resonate beyond the locker room. Maintain the support of your team's board and enthusiastic fanbase by consistently securing victories, delivering thrilling performances, and fielding fan-favorite heroes. Balance popularity with performance to keep morale high and your career secure.

Navigate an immersive player market, filled with dynamic opportunities to buy, borrow, sell, or loan players. This living marketplace allows you to strategically build your dream squad, balancing immediate needs with long-term potential and financial constraints.

Personality matters. Players come alive with unique traits and emotional responses that shape their interactions with teammates, management decisions, and in-game events. Foster positive chemistry among your team, manage player happiness, and handle internal dynamics carefully—failure to do so could see star players leaving for greener pastures.

Players grow and gain valuable experience through participation in matches and training sessions, enhancing their skills and unlocking new abilities as they age. However, aging brings its own strategic depth, as older players experience stamina reductions and eventually face retirement, forcing you to scout and cultivate younger talent continuously.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan capable
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
